data.body:
Phase 1 confirmed root cause and legitimacy. Dynamic proof: in an ephemeral git-backed tracker, I created an in-progress bug, minted a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS whose verified-at-sha equaled the close ref, verified that stored record as certified, replaced the completion provider with a counting spy, and closed at that exact SHA. Current main called the provider once. The probe passed only when asserting calls == 1, then the temporary instrumentation was removed and the worktree returned clean.

Mechanism: close_precheck._completion_precheck (src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py:639-652) unconditionally calls close_autoresume.verify_with_auto_resume after deterministic guards. That helper enters its loop and calls llm.verify_completion immediately (src/rebar/_commands/close_autoresume.py:91-138); it never reads the existing completion-verifier attestation. The signature path already authenticates the record and exposes its signed SHA/material fields (src/rebar/signing.py:656-680; src/rebar/_opcert_signing.py:463-505), and current_material_fingerprint supplies the freshness comparison. The closed adolescent-evilminded-locust ticket is not a duplicate: it retries insufficiency-only FAILs within one close and deliberately invokes the provider again.

The user-approved ticket contract establishes defect legitimacy: a valid ticket-contained attested PASS at the same resolved ref must be reused, while invalid/stale/different-ref evidence must fall through to fresh verification. The standalone verify-completion command is render-only and produced no stored attestation in the motivating sequence; changing it into a mutating producer is explicitly out of scope. Expected post-fix behavior: an eligible same-ref stored completion op-cert yields zero provider calls, then the existing locked close and post-close signing path runs unchanged. Caller sweep: verify_with_auto_resume has one production caller, the shared close precheck used by CLI/MCP/library closes; no caller depends on paying for a redundant verifier run. All ineligible records retain the current provider path.
